tagline: My beautiful universe in one person ✦
love_messages: Every love story is beautiful, but ours is my favorite...
You are my favorite notification, my favorite distraction...
This space was made for you — beautiful, warm, and full of light...
Somewhere in every poem is your name, even when I don't write it...

surprise_messages.msg: Did you know that you are the most beautiful thing in my universe? Not poetically. Literally. Scientifically.
I was just thinking about you. I wanted you to know. That's all. You were on my mind and my mind has very good taste.
Somewhere in my chest there is a feeling I don't have a word for yet. It only happens when I think about you.
I love you in the morning before you're fully awake. I love you in the afternoon when you're tired. I love you always.
If I could bottle up the feeling of being with you, I'd make it the rarest thing in the world. Because it already is.

reasons.text: Your laugh fills every room with warmth I never want to leave
The way your eyes light up when you're excited about something small
How you make ordinary moments feel like beautiful memories
Your kindness toward everyone, even strangers — it reveals your heart
The way you hum softly when you're lost in thought
Your strength — gentle and fierce at exactly the right moments
How you make my world softer, warmer, and infinitely more beautiful
The dreams you carry — vast, luminous, and uniquely yours
Being near you feels like coming home to a place I never want to leave
